name: Ensemble pour la Transition Alimentaire (+ Étudiants & Innovation alimentaire)
geography: France (+ Carrefour countries via local branches)
sector_focus: Food transition, sustainable and solidarity-based food, fight against food waste
eligible_org_type: Associations governed by the 1901 law / structures of general interest
funding_range: Not publicly disclosed (amounts vary per edition)
application_process: Annual call for projects 'Together for the Food Transition' (with Carmila) - online application during the open periods
required_documents: Not publicly detailed - typically: articles of association, bank details, provisional budget, project presentation
notes: Two components identified: 'Together for the Food Transition' and 'Students & Food Innovation'. Financial details not confirmed by fetch direct (page blocked) - verify on the official website before use in production.

name: Appels a projets - Alimentation durable / Nourrir l'avenir
geography: France AND Spain (foundation active in both countries - celebrating 10 years of commitment in Spain)
sector_focus: Transformation of food systems / sustainable food (the 'citizen art' aspect is not relevant here)
eligible_org_type: Associations, research structures, communities according to the call
funding_range: Not confirmed in the pages consulted
application_process: Several thematic calls for projects per cycle - submission via 'Submit your project' on fondationcarasso.org
required_documents: Variable depending on the call - not publicly detailed
deadline_cycle: Several calls per year, specific dates per theme
notes: A rare example of a foundation present in both France and Spain, exactly the perimeter of Phenix - a good candidate for a cross-border match.

name: Fondation Bel - appel a projets nutrition infantile
geography: Countries where Bel is established (France + international)
sector_focus: Infant nutrition, combating malnutrition, subsistence farming, food education
eligible_org_type: Structures of general interest
application_process: Online application via demandes.fondation-bel.org, selection by the Board of Directors
required_documents: Online application form (detailed content not confirmed)
deadline_cycle: Annual (e.g., closing mid-March, results in May - to be reconfirmed each year)
notes: One of the few funders to publish a clear amount range (5-25k EUR) - good concrete example for the demo.

name: Fondation Auchan pour la Jeunesse
geography: France + countries where Auchan has a presence
sector_focus: Access to quality food, combating malnutrition, social connection around meals
eligible_org_type: Non-profit organizations
application_process: Project jointly led by an Auchan employee and an association, evaluated by a country committee
deadline_cycle: Varies depending on the country committee
notes: Requires sponsorship by an Auchan employee - especially useful if the association already has a contact at Auchan (e.g., via a Phenix store partnership).

name: Nourrir les possibles / Programme Alimentation et Insertion
sector_focus: Food and social inclusion, student food aid, French food culture
eligible_org_type: Associations
funding_type: Grant + crowdfunding matching ('Nourrir les possibles' program with Ulule)
application_process: Annual call for applications via the dedicated Ulule platform
deadline_cycle: Annual - an edition cited as closed on April 13, 2026
notes: The specific 'Food and Integration' program targets food aid by and for students - relevant if the persona includes student associations.

name: Stop Hunger France
sector_focus: Fighting hunger, redistribution of surplus food from institutional catering
eligible_org_type: Primarily large federations (with established partnerships with FFBA and Restos du Coeur) rather than small, isolated associations.
funding_type: In-kind donations (surpluses), one-off financial donations, employee volunteering
funding_range: Not structured like a classic grant
application_process: No open application portal identified - operates through direct partnership
notes: WARNING: Not a truly accessible landlord for a small, isolated association – especially if partnered with large federations. Include it for matching purposes, but with a 'probably indirect access' flag.

name: FSE+ Priorite 5 - Aide alimentaire et materielle aux plus demunis (ex-FEAD)
organization: Etat francais / Union europeenne (programme national FSE+ et FTJ)
geography: The entire country is covered for material aid; the strict food aid component appears to be limited to the outermost regions, according to the page consulted.
sector_focus: Food and material aid for the most destitute
eligible_org_type: Associations authorized to provide food aid (operational management via FranceAgriMer)
funding_range: Total budget ~30 million EUR for the priority (amount per project not specified)
application_process: Calls for projects published on fse.gouv.fr, operational management via FranceAgriMer for the food component
required_documents: Standard ESF+ grant application file (not detailed here)
deadline_cycle: Periodic calls for projects, with a schedule that varies by region.
notes: Successor to the FEAD (mentioned in the Senate report on food aid financing). Exact scope of the food component for a metropolitan association to be reconfirmed with FranceAgriMer.

name: Aide aux etudes pour la lutte contre le gaspillage alimentaire
sector_focus: Studies and assessments for the fight against food waste
eligible_org_type: Associations, communities, businesses
funding_type: Grant for study (not for regular operating expenses)
funding_range: Not specified in the pages consulted
application_process: Applications can be submitted via the regional ADEME schemes / aides-territoires.beta.gouv.fr
deadline_cycle: Continuous / as needed, depending on the region
notes: Funding for STUDIES, not the day-to-day running of the association - useful if the project includes a diagnostic/impact study, less relevant for financing the van or rent.

name: Appel a projets Fondation groupe Casino
sector_focus: Social connection and personal development - several 2025 award winners linked to student food insecurity
eligible_org_type: local associations
application_process: Annual call for projects via the Ulule platform
notes: 3 winners 2025 identified on student food insecurity (Happy Toque, 1 Cabas pour 1 Etudiant, Les Petites Cantines du Forez) - the theme is eligible but not guaranteed each edition.

name: Projet Banlieues
sector_focus: Education, employment, social cohesion in priority neighborhoods
eligible_org_type: Association law 1901, apolitical, secular, non-community, based in/near a QPV, >=3 years of existence, annual budget <1M EUR, recent audited accounts, INDEPENDENT (not affiliated to a national network)
application_process: Apply online via the dedicated platform
required_documents: Audited accounts (post-end of 2022), articles of association, project presentation
deadline_cycle: 2026: Filing January 28 - March 9; Decision June 24; Notification from July 5
notes: Important exclusion criterion: the association must NOT be part of a national network - excludes a local branch of a large federation but not a small independent association in QPV.

name: Fondation VINCI pour la Cite
geography: France, priority given to disadvantaged neighborhoods and rural municipalities with fewer than 2000 inhabitants
sector_focus: Professional integration, employment, social cohesion
eligible_org_type: Association/foundation of general interest, <30% commercial revenue, itself the project leader (not a network head)
funding_type: Funding for tangible assets (equipment, vehicles, IT, furniture) or intangible assets (website, training)
application_process: Requires sponsorship by one or more VINCI employees
deadline_cycle: Continuous, through the course of sponsorships
notes: Funding specifically for vehicles and equipment – ​​could cover the van/collection logistics. However, a VINCI employee is required as a sponsor.

name: Appel a partenaires (Education et Insertion)
sector_focus: Education and integration (theme of the last call identified)
eligible_org_type: local associations
application_process: Call for partners (periodic)
notes: Not specifically food-related - eligible only if the project clearly relates to integration/education.

name: Associations, a vos projets / Coups de Coeur Citoyens
sector_focus: Diversity, social connection, mobility
eligible_org_type: local associations
funding_type: Subsidy (amounts vary depending on the scheme)
application_process: Associations, your projects! (classic call for proposals) + Citizens' Favorites (nomination by an SNCF employee)
required_documents: Rules available in PDF for Citizens' Choice Awards
notes: Coups de Coeur Citoyens' operates by nominating an SNCF employee - useful if the association has a railway worker contact.

name: Fondation Up - actions de solidarite territoriale
sector_focus: Solidarity and territorial proximity
eligible_org_type: local associations
application_process: Not detailed publicly in the pages found
notes: A group historically linked to meal vouchers – a thematic connection to food – but the focus is confirmed to be 'territorial solidarity' in a broad sense. Further investigation is needed before relying on it.

name: Appel a projets Fondation ENGIE
sector_focus: Social and solidarity-based innovation (a related but distinct theme from energy poverty addressed by FAPE ENGIE)
eligible_org_type: Associations
application_process: Periodic call for projects (partnership identified with La France s'engage)
notes: Do not confuse with the Agir Pour l'Emploi Foundation (FAPE ENGIE), which is specifically about professional integration, not food.

name: Appel a projets 'Sante et grande precarite'
organization: AG2R La Mondiale - Fondation pour la solidarite
sector_focus: Health and extreme poverty (may overlap with malnutrition / access to healthcare for vulnerable people)
eligible_org_type: Associations / health and social action structures
application_process: Call for projects published in PDF brochure
notes: Not a dedicated food fund - eligible only if the project has a clearly identifiable health/malnutrition focus.

name: Appel a projets Fondation Air France
geography: France + international depending on service areas
sector_focus: Education, training, and integration of people with disabilities or vulnerabilities
eligible_org_type: Associations
application_process: Annual call for projects, application guide available in PDF
required_documents: Application guide available (detailed content not extracted)
notes: Not food-related by default - eligible only if the project has a clearly identifiable education/training/integration focus.

name: Reseau des 39 Fondations regionales Credit Agricole (ex: Pays de France)
geography: France - 39 regional branches, each with its own foundation and its own themes/cycles
sector_focus: Variable by region and by edition - e.g. 2026 France: natural heritage and health (NOT food this year)
eligible_org_type: Local associations within the territory of the Regional Fund
funding_range: Order of magnitude: ~1.3M EUR spread across >140 projects since 2021 for the Pays de France foundation alone (not an amount per project)
application_process: Annual call for projects, submission deadline approximately one month before summer (France region), joint committee: Foundation + Crédit Agricole + experts
deadline_cycle: Annual, calendar specific to each regional branch
official_link: https://fondation-ca-paysdefrance.org/ (exemple - il existe 38 autres fondations regionales)
notes: This is not a single fund but a network of 39 independent regional foundations. The food-related theme is not guaranteed – please check with each individual foundation depending on the location of the association.

name: Appels a projets Fondation de France (pauvrete / exclusion / alimentation durable)
sector_focus: Combating exclusion, precariousness, and inequalities from a very young age; 'Better food for all' identified in at least one region
eligible_org_type: Associations of general interest
application_process: Several thematic calls for projects are published continuously on their portal.
deadline_cycle: Multiple calls per year, variable schedule
notes: Large, generalist foundation with numerous ongoing calls – requires regular portal monitoring rather than a fixed schedule. A good candidate for automated/recurring scanning by the product's AI.

name: FDVA - Fonctionnement et projets innovants
organization: Etat francais (gestion departementale via les prefectures)
geography: France, managed at the departmental level
sector_focus: Operations and innovative projects of associations, all sectors
eligible_org_type: Any association governed by the 1901 law (excluding religious associations and party financing associations)
funding_range: Variable by department, generally in the order of a few thousand euros
application_process: Applications must be submitted via the 'Le Compte Asso' platform, an annual call for projects managed by each prefecture.
required_documents: Standard Association Account File: statutes, bank details, provisional budget, activity report
deadline_cycle: Annual, dates set by each prefecture (generally in the spring)
notes: The most relevant public funding for the identified problem is explicitly intended to cover the association's operating costs (rent, transportation, etc.), not for a specific project. This type of funding exists in all French departments.

name: Subventions CCAS / CIAS (action sociale communale)
geography: France, municipal/inter-municipal level (varies by municipality - no single national portal)
sector_focus: Local social action, food aid often included depending on the municipality
eligible_org_type: Local associations operating within the municipality
funding_range: Highly variable depending on the size of the municipality
application_process: Grant application submitted to the town hall/CCAS
required_documents: Standard CERFA grant application form (articles of association, bank details, budget, activity report)
deadline_cycle: Annual, generally linked to the vote on the municipal budget.
official_link: Variable par commune - pas de portail national unique
source_verified_url: Rapport du Senat sur le financement de l'aide alimentaire (~122,5M EUR apportes par les CCAS/CIAS au niveau national) - https://www.senat.fr/rap/r18-034/r18-0342.html
notes: Not one source, but approximately 35,000 potential entities (one per municipality) – a good candidate for a 'find your local social services center' module rather than a single information sheet. Significant national aggregate amount (€122.5 million/year) according to the Senate.

name: Fondation Picard
sector_focus: Food insecurity, sustainable food, food/environment
eligible_org_type: Associations and organizations of general interest
application_process: Foundation selects and financially supports associations
notes: Very strong Phenix match: foundation explicitly has two missions — sustainable food and fighting food insecurity. It supports financially associations every year. Picard

name: Fondation Bouygues Telecom – Incub'Asso
sector_focus: Social innovation, volunteering, association development
eligible_org_type: Young / developing associations meeting program criteria
application_process: Competitive call for applications
notes: Particularly interesting for your concept because support includes association development, potentially helping small charities professionalize fundraising.

name: Fondation Groupe RATP
sector_focus: Social inclusion, employment, mobility, access to city
eligible_org_type: Associations of general interest
application_process: Project submission / employee sponsorship depending on program
notes: Stronger match when food-aid activity is connected to social inclusion or local mobility.

name: Fonds Groupe SEB / Fondation Groupe SEB
sector_focus: Social inclusion, entrepreneurship, food-related social impact
eligible_org_type: Associations / social-impact organizations
application_process: Project-based selection
notes: Potential food-sector corporate prospect, but less directly food-aid focused than Picard.

name: Fondation RAJA-Danièle Marcovici
sector_focus: Women, poverty, social inclusion
eligible_org_type: Associations / NGOs
application_process: Calls for projects / partnership
notes: Useful for associations where food aid is combined with women's empowerment or poverty reduction.

name: Fondation L'OCCITANE
sector_focus: Women's empowerment, disability, biodiversity
eligible_org_type: NGOs / associations
application_process: Project / partnership selection
notes: Broad social-impact funder; food aid is not a primary theme.

name: Fondation Pierre Bellon
sector_focus: Youth, education, entrepreneurship, social inclusion
eligible_org_type: General-interest organizations
application_process: Project submission / selection
notes: Relevant to associations working with youth or vulnerable populations.

name: Fondation M6
sector_focus: Reintegration, social inclusion, vulnerable populations
eligible_org_type: Associations / organizations
application_process: Project-based applications
notes: Useful for broader social-inclusion matching rather than pure food aid.

name: Programme National pour l'Alimentation (PNA)
sector_focus: Sustainable, healthy and socially inclusive food systems; food insecurity
eligible_org_type: Associations and other eligible project structures
application_process: Call for projects
notes: Strong fit for projects combining food access, sustainability and food-system transformation.

name: FEADER – Transition alimentaire / systèmes alimentaires locaux
sector_focus: Food transition, local food systems, circular economy, waste reduction
eligible_org_type: Associations, local authorities and eligible project organizations
application_process: Regional calls for projects
notes: Particularly relevant where food aid is combined with local food systems or food-waste reduction.

name: FEDER – Programmes régionaux
sector_focus: Ecological transition, innovation, infrastructure, circular economy
eligible_org_type: Depends on regional call
application_process: Regional calls for projects
notes: Better suited to food-waste technology, logistics and infrastructure than ordinary food distribution.

name: « Mieux manger pour tous » 2026
sector_focus: Food aid, access to fresh/local produce, logistics and white zones
eligible_org_type: Associations governed by the 1901 law and authorized to provide food aid (CASF L.266-2)
funding_range: Variable depending on the project (maximum public co-financing 80%)
application_process: Application via the Simplified Procedures platform or regional DREETS application
required_documents: CERFA form no. 12156*06, Bank details, Kbis/SIRENE extract (less than 3 months old), Articles of Association, Previous year accounts, Equipment quotes
notes: Priority funder for the logistical modernization of food aid.

name: SNANC (Stratégie Nationale Alimentation Nutrition)
organization: Ministère de l'Agriculture et de la Souveraineté Alimentaire
sector_focus: Solidarity-based supply chain, Territorial Food Projects (PAT), fight against food waste
eligible_org_type: Associations, solidarity networks, PAT project leaders
application_process: Application file submitted via the Simplified Procedures platform
required_documents: National form, provisional budget, N-1 financial statement, bank details, SIRET number
notes: Call for projects focused on structuring solidarity food networks.

name: Fondation Abbé Pierre - Accès aux Besoins Fondamentaux
sector_focus: Combating extreme poverty, precariousness, access to basic needs and food
eligible_org_type: Social action associations (governed by the 1901 law) providing emergency assistance
application_process: Submitting your application to the FAP regional agencies
required_documents: Presentation file, provisional budget, articles of association, certified accounts, bank details
deadline_cycle: Annual / ongoing depending on the urgency
notes: Priority should be given to projects with unconditional access for people in extreme poverty.

name: Fondation Le Roch-Les Mousquetaires
sector_focus: Local solidarity, local food aid, mutual aid equipment
eligible_org_type: Locally rooted non-profit organizations
application_process: Submitting application to the foundation
required_documents: Articles of association, SIRET number, bank details, equipment quote, latest activity report
notes: Regular funding focused on equipment acquisition and local solidarity.

name: Fondation MACIF - Innovation Sociale & Mobilisation
sector_focus: Supportive housing, mobility, health, intergenerational connections and inclusion
eligible_org_type: Social and solidarity economy associations governed by the 1901 law
application_process: Submission via the dedicated portal + evaluation by the MACIF regional committee
required_documents: Articles of association, bank details, budget for the project, certified accounts for the previous year (N-1)
notes: Strongly supports innovative projects that promote autonomy and social connection.

name: Fondation Système U - Solidarité & Accès Alimentaire
sector_focus: Local food aid, fighting hunger, support for food banks
eligible_org_type: Non-profit organizations / food aid organizations
application_process: Local partnership with U stores + deposit on the foundation portal
required_documents: Articles of association, SIRET number, bank details, local impact project, N-1 financial statements
notes: Historical partner of Action Against Hunger; direct support for local food drives and projects.

name: Fondation Daunat - Lutte contre la Précarité Alimentaire
sector_focus: General and student food assistance, donation of fresh produce (sandwiches, salads)
eligible_org_type: Food aid associations, student networks (e.g., Linkee, Food Banks)
application_process: Submission of partnership file to the Daunat Foundation
required_documents: Articles of association, bank details, food aid/CASF approval, provisional budget
notes: A very active agri-food industrialist in donating unsold fresh produce and providing financial support to student associations.

name: Programme Malin - Nutrition Infantile Solidaire
sector_focus: Nutrition for children under 3 years old, budget support and access to infant products
eligible_org_type: Parenting support associations, solidarity grocery stores, community centers
application_process: Call for projects / Territorial partnership via the Action Tank
required_documents: Articles of association, SIRET number, bank details, action plan targeting early childhood, financial statements
notes: High-impact niche: targeted funding and vouchers for maternal and infant nutrition for low-income families.

name: Fondation Nexity - Logement & Inclusivité
sector_focus: Accommodation, social inclusion, co-financing of emergency actions (including food aid)
eligible_org_type: Social action associations governed by the 1901 law (e.g., Secours Populaire)
application_process: Responding to calls for projects on the Nexity Foundation portal
required_documents: Articles of association, bank details, certified accounts for the previous year, description of the solidarity project
notes: It takes a comprehensive housing/integration approach, but very often co-finances food components with its partner associations.

name: Fondation Apprentis d'Auteuil (via Fondations Abritées)
sector_focus: Vulnerable youth, education, socio-professional integration, and access to basic needs
eligible_org_type: Partner associations/projects targeting young people and families in precarious situations
application_process: Project submission via hosted foundations (e.g., Fondation Un pas avec toi) or ESF+ calls for proposals
required_documents: Application file, statutes, integration/youth project, provisional budget
notes: Supports comprehensive support actions for young people (including the food/subsistence component in integration pathways).

name: Fondation Caritas France - Lutte contre la Pauvreté
organization: Fondation Caritas France (sous égide Secours Catholique)
geography: France (focus outside major metropolitan areas) + International
sector_focus: Combating exclusion, housing, integration through employment, reception centers and food
eligible_org_type: Associations governed by the 1901 law and of general interest (less than 2 years old for the Young Shoots Prize)
funding_range: Variable (e.g., Young Startups Prize for associations <2 years old / <€250k budget)
application_process: Targeted partnerships and Young Startups competitions (no open public call for projects in 2026)
required_documents: Articles of association, bank details, certified annual accounts, social action/accommodation file
deadline_cycle: Targeted sessions / Annual Young Shoots Award
notes: A major patron of grassroots social action; favours structuring multi-year partnerships and emerging associative ventures.

name: Fondation Transdev
sector_focus: Social inclusion, employment, mobility, support for vulnerable populations
eligible_org_type: Associations / organisations of general interest
funding_range: Up to €12,000 reported for project support
application_process: Call for projects / project submission; projects generally require a Transdev employee sponsor
notes: Useful for associations where food aid is linked to mobility, employment or social inclusion. Employee sponsorship requirement can be a key eligibility constraint.

name: Fondation SFR / SFR Solidaire
sector_focus: Social inclusion, equality, solidarity, digital and social empowerment
eligible_org_type: Associations / ESS organisations / eligible public-interest structures
application_process: Call for projects / online application
notes: Not food-specific. More relevant when a food-aid association also has a digital inclusion, equality or social-inclusion component.

name: Fondation Crédit Mutuel Nord Europe
geography: France, primarily Hauts-de-France, Marne and Ardennes
sector_focus: Social action, exclusion, inclusion, sustainable development, entrepreneurship
eligible_org_type: Associations / organisations of general interest
application_process: Calls for projects and foundation applications
notes: Strong regional funder for social inclusion and exclusion. Geographic eligibility should be matched against the charity's location. The foundation has supported vulnerable and socially excluded populations.

name: Fondation d'entreprise Caisse d'Épargne Loire-Centre
sector_focus: Social inclusion, autonomy, socio-professional integration, support for vulnerable people
eligible_org_type: Associations, foundations and other organisations of general interest
application_process: Call for projects via the foundation's online application platform
notes: Regional rather than national. 2026 programme supported solidarity projects in Centre-Val de Loire, including socio-professional integration and support for vulnerable people.

name: Fonds d'action sanitaire et sociale – Assurance Maladie
organization: Caisse nationale de l'Assurance Maladie / Assurance Maladie
sector_focus: Access to rights and healthcare, social and health vulnerability, reduction of social inequalities
eligible_org_type: Associations / foundations with non-profit status and eligible public-interest activities
application_process: Call for projects / submission to Assurance Maladie; local CPAM programmes may also exist
required_documents: Cerfa 12156-06, statutes, declaration, board list, N-1 financial accounts, activity report, URSSAF certificate, RIB, Republican Commitment contract, relevant quotations
notes: Not a food-aid fund. Relevant only where food insecurity is connected to health/social vulnerability. The 2026 national call explicitly excluded structural operating costs and investments.
